details.body: Jab, v. t. apa-, vyaD 4 P.

Jabber, v. t. prajalp 1 P, pralap 1 P, avyaktaM-aspazwaM-vad 1 P, tvaritaM vac 2 P. [Jabber]er, s. vAcAlaH-waH, vAvadUkaH, jalpa(lpA)-kaH. [Jabber]ing, s. jalpaH, pralApaH, prajalpaH, aspazwaM vacanaM.
JABBER: jalpati (jalp, c. 1.): v. To babble.

To JABBER , v. n. jalp (c. 1. jalpati -lpituM), upajalp, tvaritaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), avyaktaM or aspazwaM vad, vad in freq. (vAvadyate), pralap (c. 1. -lapati -pituM), cawacawa (nom. cawacawAyate), anarTakavacanaM kf.
JABBERER: jalpAkaH: v. Babbler.
JABBERER , s. jalpakaH, jalpAkaH, jalpI m. (n), upajalpI m., vAcAlaH, vAcAwaH, vAvadUkaH, bahuBAzI m. (n), aspazwavaktA m. (ktf).
JABBERING: jalpitam, pra-: v. Babbling.
JABBERING , s. jalpaH -lpanaM, prajalpaH, jalpitaM, vAvadUkatA, pralApaH, vipralApaH, pralapitaM, tvaritavacanaM, aspazwavacanaM, avyaktavacanaM, nirarTakavacanaM.
Jack, s. panasaH. 2 vfkzaH, upastaMBaH, ADAraH; ‘j(ack)-fruit’ panasaM.
JACK: J. The tree: (1) panasaH;(2) kaRwakiPalaH. II The fruit: panasam.III A fellow: mARavakaH.IV For boots: *nizkarzakaH.V A pike: jalasUciH.VI A frame: BAraH.

JACK , s. (Instrument for pulling off boots) pAdukAnizkarzaRayantraM. — (Instrument for turning a spit) yantraM yaddvAreRa pAkaSUlaH pari- varttate. — (A fish) jalasUciH m. — (Coat of mail) kavacaH -caM, tanutraM. — (Horse, wooden frame) maYcaH, vfkzaH, upastamBaH, ADAraH. — (Male of certain animals) expressed by puM prefixed. — (Flag at the end of a bow-sprit) nOkAgravahiHpralambo DvajapawaH. — (Bread- fruit tree) panasaH, panasanAlikA, kagadakiPalaH.
JACK-A-LANTERN: BUtadIpikA; mUtAlokaH.
JACK-A-LANTERN , s. piSAcadIpikA, BUtadIpikA, miTyAdIptiH f.
JACK-BOOTS , s. pl. carmmanirmmitaM jaNGottarIyaM or jaNGAtrARaM, vfhatpAdukA.
JACK-DAW: kAkaviSeza.
JACK-DAW , s. kAkajAtIyaH pakziBedaH, kAkaviSezaH, kAkaH, vAyasaH.
JACK-KETCH , s. GAtukapuruzaH, daRqapASikaH, mftapAH m., udbanDakaH
JACK-PUDDING: BaRqaH: v. Buffoon.
JACK-PUDDING , s. BaRqaH, BARqaH, vEhAsikaH, parihAsavedI m. (n), vidUzakaH.
Jackal, s. Sf(sf)gAlaH, gomAyuH, jaMbU(bu)kaH, krozwu m., PeravaH, BUrimAyaH, SivA, mfgaDUrtakaH, vaMcu(ca) kaH, PeruH.
JACKAL: (1) SfgAlaH;(2) gomAyuH;(3) jambukaH; (4) PeruH or PeravaH.

JACKAL , s. SfgAlaH, sfgAlaH, jambukaH, jambUkaH, gomAyuH m., vaYcakaH, krozwA m. (zwu), gomI m. (n), kraSvA m. (n), BUrimAyaH GorarAsanaH, hUravaH, SvaBIruH m., PeraH, PeraRqaH, PeravaH. — (Female) SfgAlI, krozwrI, SivA.
Jackanapes, s. vAnaravftti f., markawaSIlaM.
JACKANAPES: I A monkey: q.v.II Fig.: vAnaraH.
JACKANAPES , s. vAnaravfttiH m., kapisvaBAvaH, markawaSIlaH, vAnaracaritraH.
Jackass, s. gardaBaH, rAsaBaH, KaraH.
JACKASS: gardaBaH (both lit.) and fig. = blockhead).
JACKASS , s. garddaBaH, rAsaBaH, KaraH, DUsaraH, cakrIvAn m. (t), vAleyaH.
Jackdaw, s. kAkaH, droRakAkaH, droRaH.
Jacket, s. kUrpAsakaH, kaMcukaH, nicolaH.
JACKET: (1) celaH, -kaH;(2) kUrpAsakaH.
JACKET , s. kaYcukaH, kaYculikA, nicolaH -lakaH, colaH -lakaH, niculaH, aNgikA, kUrpAsakaH.
Jack-ketch, s. GAtakapuruzaH, udbaMDakaH.
Jack-pudding, s. BaMqaH, vidUzakaH, vEhAsikaH.
JACOBIN , s. hInavarRapakzapAtI m. (n), rAjadrohI m. (n), rAjayuDvA m. (n).
JACOB'S-STAFF , s. (Pilgrim's staff) kArpawikadaRqaH, kArpawikayazwiH m. f. — (A staff concealing a weapon) kUwAyuDaM, kUwAstraM, antarguptani- SitAstro vahiHkAzWamayo daRqaH.
Jaculate, v. t. nira-, as 4 P.
JADDED (adj.): (1) jarjaraH (rA, raM);(2) banDaraH (rA, raM) (as of rocks).

Jade, s. kadaSvaH, aSvakaH. 2 puMScalI, baMDakI, kulawA, BrazwA, asatI, asADvI. v. t. Kid c., klam c., Sram c., Ayas c., avasad c. v. i. Sram 4 P, klam 1, 4 P, Ayas 1, 4 P, avasad 1 P, Kid pass. glE 1 P. [Jad]ed, a. klAMta, SrAMta, Kinna, SramArta, glAna. Jadish, a. duzwa, pApIyas, kutsita, ku-kad-dur pr.
JADE (subs.): I A bad horse: kadaSvaH.II A bad woman: banDakI.
JADE (v.): Kedayati (c. of Kid): v. To tire. J. d: KinnaH (nnA, nnaM): v. Fatigued.
JADE , s. (Sorry horse) kadaSvaH, aSvataraH, aSvakah. — (A name of reproach for a woman) banDakI, kulawA, BrazwA, pApIyasI. See JADISH.

To JADE , v. a. Kid (c. 10. Kedayati -yituM), Ayas (c. 10. -yAsayati -yituM), Sram (c. 10. Sramayati -yituM), klam (c. 10. klamayati -yituM), sad (c. 10. sAdayati -yituM), avasad, kliS (c. 9. kliSnAti, kleSituM), tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM), kfz (c. 10. karzayati -yituM), kazwaM kf.

To JADE , v. n. (Become weary) Kid in pass. (Kidyate), Ayas (c. 4. -yasyati -yasituM), Sram (c. 4. SrAmyati, SramituM), klam (c. 4. klA- myati, klamituM), sad (c. 1. sIdati, sattuM), avasad, kazwa (nom. kazwAyate).
JADED , p. p. KinnaH -nnA -nnaM, KeditaH -tA -taM, SrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, pariSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, SramArttaH -rttA -rttaM, klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, glAnaH -nA -naM.

JADISH , a. (Bad) duzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), kutsitaH -tA -taM, ku or kad or dur prefixed. — (Unchaste, applied to a woman) banDakI, asatI, asADvI, vyaBicAriRI, puMScalI, DfzwA, DarziRI, avinItA, kAmagA.
Jag, s. BaMgaH, daMtaH, CedaH. v. t. BaMgurI-daMturI-kf 8 U, krakacarUpeRa Cid 7 P. [Jag]ged, [Jag]gy, a. daMtura, anukrakaca, BaMgura, krakacAkAra.
JAG , JAGG, s. (Notch) CedaH, avacCedaH, vicCedaH, BaNgaH, dantaH, krakacada- ntarUpo BaNgaH or CedaH.

To JAGG , v. a. jarjjarIkf, krakacadantarUpeRa Cid (c. 7. Cinatti, CettuM) or viCid or avaCid, CedaM kf, avacCedaM kf, krakacarUpeRa BaNguraM -rAM -raM kf, or BaNgurIkf or jarjjaraM -rAM -raM kf, jarjjarIkaM -kAM -kaM kf.

JAGGED , p. p. a. jarjjaraH -rA -raM, jarjjarIkaH -kA -kaM, krakacadantarUpeRa vicCinnaH -nnA -nnaM or danturaH -rA -raM or dantI -ntinI -nti (n), anukrakacaH -cA -caM, krakacayArAkAraH -rA -raM, BaNguraH -rA -raM, vizamaDAraH -rA -raM.
JAGGEDNESS , s. jarjjaratA, jarjjarIkatA, danturatvaM, BaNguratvaM.
Jaggery, s. guqaH, matsyaMqI, PaRitaM.
JAGGY , a. danturaH -rA -raM, anukrakacaH -cA -caM. See JAGGED.
Jail, s. kArA, kArAgfhaM, kArAgAraM, kArAveSman n., baMDanAgAraM, baMDanAlayaH, baMDana-niroDa-sTAnaM, baMdiSAlA, gupti f. [Jail]er, s. kArADyakzaH, baMdipAlaH, kArADipatiH, kArAgfhAvekzakaH.
JAIL: (1) kArA, -gArama;(2) cAraH, -kaH;(2) banDanA- layaH.
JAIL , s. kArA, kArAgAraM, kArAgfhaM, kArAveSma n. (n), banDanAgAraM, banDa- nAlayaH, banDanagfhaM, banDanasTAnaM, niroDasTAnaM, vandiSAlA, guptiH f., cAraH.
JAIL-BIRD: kArABogin (f. nI) (?); BuktacArakaH (kA, kaM) (?).
JAILER: (1) kArADyakzaH;(2) cArakanAyakaH; and sim. comp.s.
JAILER , s. kArArakzakaH, kArAgfhADyakzaH, kArAgArADipatiH m., banDanA- layarakzakaH, guptipAlakaH, vandipAlaH.
JAKES , s. SOcakUpaH, pAyukzAlanaveSma n. (n), avaskarasTAnaM.
JALAP: *jalapam; recakamUlaviSezaH.
Jam, s. mizwAnnaM, svAdvannaM, saMDitaM. v. t. saM-pIq 10, saMbAD 1 A, saMmfd 9 P, kliS 9 P [Jam]med, a. saMpIqita, saMbADa, saMkula, saMkawa.
JAM: *pizwamizwam, greengage j.: *haritakapizwaBizwam.
JAM , s. mizwaPalaM, mizwAnnaM, svAdvannaM, sanDitaPalaM, sanDitaM.
To JAM , v. a. sampIq (c. 10. -pIqayati -yituM), sammfd (c. 9. -mfdnAti -marddituM), sambAD (c. 1. -bADate -DituM), saNkulIkf, saNkawIkf.
JAMB: avagrahaRI (?), A.
JAMB , s. upastamBaH, avazwamBaH -mBanaM, stamBaH, gfhastamBaH, ADAraH.
JAMMED , p. p. sampIqitaH -tA -taM, sammardditaH -tA -taM, sambADaH -DA -DaM, saNkulaH -lA -laM, saNkawaH -wA -waM, cUrRitaH -tA -taM.
Jangle, v. t. vi-vad 1 A, vipra-lap 1 P, vi-prati-pad 4 A, kalahaM kf 8 U. v. t. Rattle, q. v. [Jangl]ing, s. vivAdaH, vipralApaH, vA-kkalahaH, vAgyudDaM.
To JANGLE , v. n. vAgyudDaM kf, vAkkalahaM kf, vivad (c. 1. -vadate -dituM), vipralApaM kf, vyavakroSanaM kf, viroDoktiM kf, kalaha (nom. kalahAyate).
JANGLE , s. (Wrangling) vAgyudDaM, vAkkalahaH, vipralApaH, vyavakroSanaM. — (Discordant sound) JaYJA -YJanaM.
JANGLER , s. vAkkalahakArI m. (n), vAgyudDapriyaH, vyavakroSanapriyaH.
JANGLING , s. (Wrangling) vAkkalahaH, vyavakroSanaM, vivAdaH. — (Discor- dant sound) JaYJA -YJanaM, JaH, karkaSasvanaH.
JANISSARY: turuzkasEnikaviSezaH.
Janitor, s. dvAHsTaH, dvArapAlaH, prati(tI)hAraH.
JANITOR , s. dvArapAlaH, dvArarakzakaH, dvArasTaH, pratihAraH, pratIhAraH.
JANTILY , adv. capalaM, cApalyena, capalaSIlatvAt, laGu, svaBAvalAGavAt.
JANTINESS , s. cApalyaM, capalaSIlatA, laGutA, svaBAvalAGavaM.
Janty, a. capala, laGu-cala-svaBAva, sarasa.
JANTY , a. capalaH -lA -laM, capalaSIlaH -lA -laM, laGusvaBAvaH -vA -vaM.
January, s. pOzamAGaM.
JANUARY: uttarapOzapUrvamAGasaMvAdIyurUpIyavarzasya praTamamAsaH.
JANUARY , s. pOzamAGaM, pOzaH, mAGaH, uttarapOzaH, pUrvvamAGaH, puzpaH, tEzaH, tizyaH -zyakaH, praTamamAsaH.
JAPAN: a varnish: *yAbanam, -kukku BaH.
JAPAN , s. jApAnnAmA citrakukkuBaviSezaH.
Jape, v. t. pari-upa-ava-has 1 P.

Jar, s. GawaH-wI, kuMBaH, kalaSaH-SI-SaM; (earthen) mfdBAMqAM, mfRmayaM pAtraM; kuwaH, nipaH; ‘a large j(ar)’ maRikaH, aliM(laM)jaraH. 2 karkaSaDvaniH-SabdaH, saMGarzaRaDvaniH, kawu-paruza-svanaH. 3 kalahaH, visaMvAdaH. 4 saMGawwaH, samAGAtaH, parasparAGAtaH. v. i. saMGaww 1 A, samAhan 2 P. 2 karkaSaM Dvan-svan 1 P. 3 vivf 1 A, kalahAyate (D.) vipra-lap 1 P [Jar]ring, a. karRakarkaSa, paruza, kawu, karkaSa-SabdakArin. 2 parasparavirudDa; See Inconsistent.
JAR (subs.): I A vessel: aliYjaraH (?). Mah. II Harsh sound: karkaSaSabdaH.III Clash, quarrel; q.v.: kalahaH. Ph.: on the j. or ajar: ardDavivftaH (tA, taM).
JAR (v.): I Of sounds: visvaraM karoti.II quarrel: q.v.

To JAR , v. n. (Make a grating sound) karkaSaSabdaM kf, JaYJA (nom. JaYJAyate), parasparaGarzaRajaM JaYJASabdaM kf. — (Clash) saNGaww (c. 1. -Gawwate -wwituM), parasparasamAGAtaM kf, parasparasaNGawwanaM kf. — (Quarrel) vivad (c. 1. -vadate -dituM), kalaha (nom. kalahAyate).

JAR , s. (Grating sound) karkaSaSabdaH, parasparaGarzaRajaH kawuSabdaH, paraspa- rasaNGawwanajo JaYJASabdaH, JaYJanaM. — (Clash) saNGawwaH -wwanaM, samAGAtaH, parasparasamAGAtaH, parasparaviroDaH. — (An earthen vessel) GawaH, kumBaH, kalaSaH -SI -SaM, maRikaM, aliYjaraH, AluH f., karkarI, kuRqI, mftti- kApAtraM, mfdBARqaM, mfRmayapAtraM, udapAtraM, jalapAtraM. — (Bottom of a jar) sUryyagrahaH. — (A little open, half open, said of a door) Izadu- dGAwitaH -tA -taM, ardDodGAwitaH -tA -taM.
Jargon, s. pralapitaM, anarTakaM vacanaM, anarTaka-vAgupacayaH; saMkIrRavAc f.
JARGON: perh. pralapitam or pralApaH.
JARGON , s. anarTakaBAzA, asambadDaBAzA, piSAcaBAzA, rAkzasI BAzA, miSritaBAzA.
JARRING (adj.): (1) karRakarkaSaH (SA, SaM);(2) visvaraH (rA, raM)
JARRING , part. or a. parasparaparAhataH -tA -taM, parasparaviroDI -DinI -Di (n), anyonyavirudDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Making a harsh sound) karkaSa- SabdakArI -riRI -ri (n).

JASMIN , s. kundaH -ndaM, jAtI -tiH f., JAwI -wA, jAtIkusumaM, mAlatI, yUTI, yUTikA, svarRayUTI, mallikA, jIvanI, suganDaH, mADuraM, sumanAH f. (s), makarandaH, mudgaraH; ‘double jasmin,’ SiSuganDA; ‘relating to the jasmin,’ kOndaH -ndI -ndaM; ‘the jasmin creeper,’ kOndI latA.

Jasmine, s. BUpadI, Sa(SI)taBIruH, mallikA, AsPowA (wild); mAgaDI, gaRikA, yUTi-kA, aMbazWA; atimuktaH, puMqrakaH; vAsaMtI, mADavI, sumanAH, mAlatI, jAti-tI f., saptalA, navamallikA-mAlikA; mAGyaM, kuMdaH-daM (different species).

JASMINE: (1) mallika (= Arabian j.);(2) mAlatI (= j. grandiflorum);(3) jAtiH (= 2);(4) navamAlikA (= double j.);(5) kundaH (= j. pube- -scens);(6) hemapuzpikA (= yellow j.). N. B. These also indicate the flowers, except (5), for which use neuter.
Jasper, s. sUryakAMtaH.
JASPER: jAPraM (in Kachari and Assamese dia- -lects).
JASPER , s. sUryyakAntaH, jAsparAKyo maRiviSezaH.
Jaundice, s. kAmalA-laH, pAMquH, pAMqurogaH [Jaundic]ed, a. kAmalopahata, pAMqugrasta. 2 sAcIkfta, satyAt parivartita.
JAUNDICE: (1) pARqurogaH;(2) pARquraH;(3) kAmalA.
JAUNDICE , s. pARquH m., pARqurogaH, pARquraH, pARqukaH, kAmalA -laH, kumBakAmalA, halImakaM; ‘incipient jaundice,’ pARqucCAyA.
JAUNDICED: I Lit.: pARqurogin (f. RI).II Fig.: dUzitaH (tA, taM).
JAUNDICED , a. (Having the jaundice) pARqurogI -giRI -gi (n), pARqurogagrastaH -stA -staM. — (Prejudiced) sAcIkftaH -tA -taM, vakradfzwiH -zwiH -zwi.
Jaunt, v. i. vihArArTaM pariBram 1, 4 P or paryad 1 P. s. vihAraH, paryawanaM.
JAUNT: I Sub.:(1) BramaRam (= rambling);(2) vihAraH or viharaRam (for pleasure), j. in a wood: vanaviharaRam, Si.II Verb: v. To ramble.
To JAUNT , v. n. pariBramaRaM kf, paryyawanaM kf, vihAraM kf, vihArArTam itastataH pariBram (c. 4. -BrAmyati -BramituM), vihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM), vihArArTaM paryyaw (c. 1. -awati -wituM).
JAUNT , s. vihAraH, viharaRaM, BramaRaM, vihArArTaM pariBramaRaM or paryyawanaM.
JAUNTY: v. Fresh, lively. J. car: vivftayAnam (?).
Javelin, s. SUlaH-laM, SalyaM, SaMkuH, prAsaH, Sakti f., astraM, kuMtaH.
JAVELIN: (1) Zalyam;(2) SUlam;(3) prAsaH: v. Dart.
JAVELIN , s. SalyaM, SalAkA, SaNkuH m., prAsaH, kzipaRiH m., SaktiH f., pARimuktaM, karamuktaM, muktakaM, muktAmuktaM, SUlaH -laM, astraM, dUraveDI m. (n), kAsUtarI.

details.body: Jaw, s. hanu m. f. 2 vaktraM, muKaM; ‘lower j(aw)’ pIcaM, kuMjaH, cibukaM, civuH, ‘locked j(aw)’ hanugrahaH; ‘j(aw)-tooth’ daMzwrA; ‘fallen in the j(aw)s of death’ mftyormuKe patitaH, mftyudaMzwrAM-targataH. 3 BartsanA, vAkpAruzyaM, tarjanaM, Akro-SaH. v. i. tarj 1 P, 10 A, Barts 10 A, AkruS 1 P. [Jaw]ed, a. hanumat, hanuviSizwa.

JAW: I Lit.: hanuH (nUH), j. ed: hanumat (f. tI); upper, lower j.: uttarA, aDarA hanuH, Ta. Lower j.: civukaH.II Fig. = mouth: q.v.: before you fall into my j. s: yAvanmama draM zwAntargato na mavAn Bavi- zyati, P. i. 8.; to the j. s of death: yamasya jamBayoH, Ta.

JAW , s. hanuH m. f., hanUH f.; ‘the lower jaw,’ pIcaM, kuYjaH, civukaM, civuH m.; ‘big-jawed,’ mahAhanuH -nuH -nu; ‘locked jaw,’ hanugrahaH, hanustamBaH; ‘jaw-tooth,’ dAQA, daMzwrA. — (Mouth) muKaM, vaktraM; ‘jaws of death,’ mftyuvaktraM. — (Scolding, abuse) AkroSaH, kruzwaM, tarjjanaM, vAkpAruzyaM, BartsanaM.
To JAW , v. n. (Scold) AkruS (c. 1. -kroSati -kozwuM), tarj (c. 10. tarjayati -yituM).
JAW-BONE , s. hanvasTi n., civukAsTi n., pIcAsTi n.
JAWED , a. hanumAn -matI -mat (t), hanUmAn &c., hanuviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
Jay, s. cAzaH-saH, kikIdiviH, kikidivaH-viH, kikIdivIH-vaH, kikiH, divaH.
JAY: (1) cAzaH;(2) kikidIviH;(3) nIlakaRWaH.
JAY , s. cAzaH, cAsaH, maRikaRWaH, nIlakaRWaH, kikiH m., kikidiviH m., kikIdivaH, kikIdIviH m., cAlaH.

Jealous, s. matsarin, samatsara, sAsUya, sABya-sUya, serzya, parotkarzAsahana, parasuKadvezin; See Envious. 2 premasaMSayin, SaMkASIla, prItyASaMkin; ‘a j(ealous) husband’ parapuruza-vyaBicAra-jAra-SaMkita; ‘a j(ealous) wife’ parastrISaM-kinI. 3 kftAdara, Adfta, sABimAna, sAvaDA-na, anupekzaka. [Jealous]ly, adv. samatsaraM, serzyaM, sAsUyaM, sAByasUyaM; sABimAnaM. [Jealous]ness, [Jealous]y, s. matsaraH, mAtsaryaM, asUyA, IrzyA, aByasUyA, sApatnyaM, parotkarzadvezaH. 2 SaMkASIlatA, vyaBicAraSaMkA, prema-prIti-SaMkA. 3 sAvaDAnatA, aBimAnAvekzA.
